title: To Retain or to Adapt? Generalizing Continual Learning
abstract: arXiv:2607.05609v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The Continual Learning (CL) literature has long been driven by the goal of mitigating catastrophic forgetting. This objective rests on an often unstated assumption: that a lifelong learner should approximate the Joint-Task Learning (JTL) solution and retain all previously acquired knowledge. We challenge this retention-centered premise, arguing that in non-stationary environments prioritizing retention can impede real-time adaptation. Shifting the focus to the Average Lifelong Error (ALE), we formalize CL as an online optimization problem governed by the interaction between environmental and learning dynamics. We introduce Transfer Efficiency as a quantitative measure of the tension between Instability, the bias inherited from conflicting past experience, and Transient Error, the optimization cost of learning new tasks from scratch. translated_title: 保留还是适应？持续学习的泛化
translated_abstract: 持续学习领域的文献长期以来一直以缓解灾难性遗忘为目标。这一目标建立在一个通常未被言明的假设之上：即终身学习者应逼近联合任务学习（JTL）的解，并保留所有先前获得的知识。我们挑战这一以保留为中心的前提，认为在非平稳环境中，优先考虑保留可能会阻碍实时适应。我们将焦点转向平均终身误差（ALE），将持续学习形式化为一个由环境动态与学习动态之间相互作用所支配的在线优化问题。我们引入迁移效率作为定量度量，用以刻画不稳定性（继承自相互冲突的过去经验的偏差）与瞬态误差（从头学习新任务所产生的优化成本）之间的张力。在温和的收敛条件下，该分解在线性模型和神经网络模型中均成立。
tldr: 该论文挑战了持续学习以“保留知识”为中心的传统假设，将持续学习重新形式化为以最小化平均终身误差为目标的在线优化问题，并提出“迁移效率”作为衡量不稳定性与瞬态误差之间张力的定量指标。
en_tdlr: This paper challenges the retention-centered premise of continual learning, reformulates CL as an online optimization problem minimizing the Average Lifelong Error, and introduces Transfer Efficiency as a quantitative measure of the tension between Instability and Transient Error.
